As part of the FSDS, the future role of the RBB in the banking system will be addressed.

Moving forward, to address the issues of financial interconnectedness, including

through connected lending, and possible cross-shareholding among banks arising from

pledging of equity shares as loan collateral, DPC3 will support the NRB in

implementing a framework and regulations for consolidated supervision and in

operationalizing a supervisory information system. The status of the recapitalization
